'''May 1999 Las Vegas Memorial Day tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed event in Las Vegas. [[Travis Merkle]] published a report on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="mem">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Memorialdayreport99.htm Memorial Day Tourney Report], The Outer Rim ([[Travis Merkle]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234402/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Memorialdayreport99.htm Internet Archive]</ref> Twenty-six players entered. [[Steven Cannon]] took first, [[Jon VanDerMeer]] second, and Merkle fourth. [[Chris Hines]] directed.
